Task: Open a COO draft; choose destination and documents; use What’s missing; correct errors; copy a goods item; save and reopen.
Expected result: All controls work with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and arrow keys. Focus is visible, logical and never trapped. Typed values survive saving.
Reviewer or equipment: NVDA with Firefox or Chrome on Windows

Task: Filter a queue; open an application; inspect Application, Files, Comments and History; return to the queue.
Expected result: Selected queue and search survive return. Dialogs restore focus. No pinned bar hides the focused control.
Reviewer or equipment: NVDA with Firefox or Chrome on Windows

Task: Read field names, required state and errors; change language; open a dialog; navigate PDF Text view headings and page buttons.
Expected result: Names, roles, states, reading order and updates are understandable without seeing the screen. File content is not announced as translated interface text.
Reviewer or equipment: NVDA and VoiceOver; experienced assistive-technology user

Task: Approve an eligible sample; reject another with a reason; inspect the resulting queues, comments and handling times.
Expected result: The intended record changes once; the decision and reason are retained; locked records remain protected. No automatic approval from merely opening evidence.

Task: Upload a real scanned PDF, office-generated invoice, form PDF and rotated or mixed-size document from your usual software.
Expected result: Every page is visible or a clear fallback is provided. Originals remain downloadable. Text view warns when text or reading-order information is missing.
Reviewer or equipment: Chamber officer using representative non-sensitive files

Task: Place a certification stamp and QR stamp, change page and size, save, reopen and print.
Expected result: Stamp positions and page count survive download and reopening. Original is unchanged. QR contains the expected sample reference.
Reviewer or equipment: Chamber officer; Acrobat and operating-system reader

Task: Print COO front/reverse, EUR1 and stamped mixed-page PDF at Actual size and the intended printer settings.
Expected result: No edges, reference numbers, goods or stamp are clipped. Orientation, page order and duplex sides match the preview.
Reviewer or equipment: Representative office printer and paper stock

Task: Repeat queue, editor, PDF and signature tasks on actual iPhone/Safari, Android/Chrome and desktop Safari; test portrait and landscape.
Expected result: Menus stay on screen, touch controls work, uploads open and forms remain usable without unwanted page-wide scrolling.
Reviewer or equipment: Actual devices; record OS and browser versions

Task: Use browser 200% and 400%, text-only enlargement, high contrast and increased text spacing; inspect errors and open dialogs.
Expected result: Content remains available, labels do not overlap, controls can be reached and focus is not covered. Local two-dimensional document scrolling is understandable.

Task: Complete a short application and review task in each of English, Dutch, Estonian, Arabic, Swedish and Portuguese.
Expected result: Business terms, grammar, error instructions, dates and plural counts are natural; Arabic direction is appropriate. Entered data and original artwork stay unchanged.

Task: With 50+ realistic records, locate a priority case, identify ownership/payment, inspect evidence, decide and return to the same queue. Repeat the same tasks on the original service.
Expected result: Record task times, wrong-record selections, errors and lost queue positions. Only claim improvement after comparable results and officer feedback.
Reviewer or equipment: Experienced officer and a user with access needs

Task: Save a record and signature; reload immediately; close and reopen the browser. Test a separate browser/profile.
Expected result: Changes remain in the original browser. Separate profiles do not share data; explain this clearly during the demonstration.
